{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Define sentinel value
sentinel_value = -999.0

# Filter for patients with SEVERE disease AND valid baseline biomarker values (not sentinel)
severe_valid = df[(df['severity'] == 'severe') & (df['biomarker_baseline'] != sentinel_value)]

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for these patients
mean_biomarker = severe_valid['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the result
print(mean_biomarker)"}
